section.title: Accessing Builds and Source Code
section.p: The source code for this package is available on the Apache web site. Individual files can be accessed using the web-based CVS interface. The entire package can be downloaded using the following instructions.

section.title: Accessing the Nightly Builds
section.p: This package is built nightly along with Axis. The build will create two zip files: wsif-bin-1.2.zip and xml-axis.wsif-src.zip. The first file contains a complete build image, which includes wsif.jar and the API Javadoc. The second file contains a copy of the source code, which could be built using Ant. Both of these files can be accessed at the same location as the Axis nightly builds.

section.title: Accessing the Source Tree (AnonCVS)
section.p: So, you've decided that you need access to the source tree to see the latest and greatest code. There's two different forms of CVS access. The first is anonymous and anybody can use it. The second is not and you must have a login to the development server. If you don't know what this means, join the mailing list and find out.
Anyone can checkout source code from our anonymous CVS server. To do so, simply use the following commands (if you are using a GUI CVS client, configure it appropriatly):
section.source:
cvs -d :pserver:anoncvs@cvs.apache.org:/home/cvspublic login password: anoncvs
cvs -d :pserver:anoncvs@cvs.apache.org:/home/cvspublic checkout ws-wsif
